ovnEip.description: OVN EIP name to use for floating IP

v4Ip.description: IPv4 address for the floating IP

v6Ip.description: IPv6 address for the floating IP

vpc.description: VPC name. This field is immutable after creation.

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the FIP's current state

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another

lastUpdateTime.description: Last time this condition was updated

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about the condition

reason.description: Reason for the condition's last transition

status.description: Status of the condition (True, False, Unknown)

ready.description: Indicates whether the FIP is ready

v4Ip.description: IPv4 address mapped to the FIP

v6Ip.description: IPv6 address mapped to the FIP

vpc.description: VPC name where the FIP is configured
